_comment: United Kingdom (data/regions/gb.geojson). Generic rules from _default.json; stat names are the ones the template filled in before this file existed. Only exemptions here: docs/qa/west-europe.md.

exemptions.reason: Railway test tracks (Rail Innovation and Development Centre at Old Dalby, High Marnham, the Coventry very light rail test track) carry no public service. Old Dalby was drawn as High-speed (125 mph in its tags) and High Marnham as Regional; the Coventry test track made Coventry a city with light rail in the search index. Rhyl Miniature Railway (381 mm, railway=light_rail) made St Asaph a city with light rail in the search index.
